title: Resolution Runbook
text:
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Owner | On-call |
| Status | CRITICAL |
| Last reviewed | 2026-08-16 |
| Audience | Internal |

1. Acknowledge the alert
2. Declare severity and open a channel
3. Mitigate (rollback / failover)
4. Verify recovery
5. Communicate resolution

```
# common mitigations
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api
kubectl scale deployment/api --replicas=6
```
